items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...How old does he look to you, my Kenry? ... [INTERVIEWEE] But he got his barbershop.

ctx.x: Claiborne, yes, St. Cook. Uh-huh. Well, we'll find him on the—just as you turn, Claiborne on the riverside of the bank, on this side of the bank. How old does he look to you, my Kenry? I haven't seen him in the—
